login.title: Log in
login.intro: Prepare for the German nursing language exam (Fachsprachprüfung Pflege) alongside your GWS German course.

errors.invalid: Email address or password is incorrect.

forgot.intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to set a new password.

errors.tooShort: The password must have at least 8 characters.
errors.generic: That did not work. Please open the link from the email again.

learn.title: Your training for the language exam
learn.intro: Practise nursing vocabulary, conversations and documentation from everyday care – in short lessons for reading, listening, writing and speaking.

mail.inviteSubject: Your invitation to the GWS language training app
mail.inviteBody:
Hello {name},

GWS talent transfer has invited you to the training app for the German nursing language exam (Fachsprachprüfung Pflege).

Set your password here:
{link}

The link is valid for 24 hours.

Best regards
Your GWS team

use this link to set a new password:
{link}

Best regards
Your GWS team

the GWS team has replied to you in the language training app:

glossary.title: Nursing terminology
glossary.intro: {count} medical terms in {topics} topics for the language exam – with article, plural, plain German explanation, English translation and example sentence. Search for a term or practise with flashcards.
glossary.searchPlaceholder: e.g. Dekubitus, blood pressure, i. v. …
glossary.results: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}}
glossary.moreResults: … and {count} more. Please refine your search.
glossary.trainMixedIntro: Mixed from all topics: unknown terms first, then new ones.
glossary.trainLearningIntro: Only terms you did not know yet.
glossary.trainEmpty: Nothing to practise here right now.
glossary.flipHintTerm: What does it mean? Think, then flip.
glossary.flipHintMeaning: What is the term with its article? Think, then flip.

glossaryAdmin.title: Medical terms
glossaryAdmin.intro: {count} terms in {topics} topics. Customers only see published topics.
glossaryAdmin.error: That didn't work. Please check your input.
glossaryAdmin.duplicate: This term already exists in this topic.
glossaryAdmin.noTerms: No terms in this topic yet.
glossaryAdmin.confirmDeleteTopic: Delete this topic with all its terms and customers' progress permanently?
glossaryAdmin.importIntro: One line per term: article; term; plural; explanation; English; example. Tabs (copied from Excel) work too. Existing terms with the same name are updated.
glossaryAdmin.imported: {count, plural, one {# term} other {# terms}} saved.
glossaryAdmin.importLineError: This line could not be read (article must be der, die, das or empty): {line}

readiness.title: Exam readiness

reasons.idle: Has not studied for more than 14 days.
reasons.manyWeak: At least 3 lessons below 70 % – needs revision.
reasons.partsMissing: At least one exam part (listening, reading, writing, speaking) not practised yet.

readiness.rule: Exam ready = at least 80 % of lessons done, average result at least 75 % and all four exam parts practised.
